import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 250015;
    static long[] inv = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] p = new long[MAXN];

    static void initialize(int MAXNUM, long mod) {
        inv[0] = inv[1] = 1;
        p[0] = p[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= MAXNUM; i++) {
            inv[i] = (mod - mod / i) * inv[(int)(mod % i)] % mod;
            p[i] = p[i - 1] * i % mod;
        }
        for (int i = 2; i <= MAXNUM; i++) {
            inv[i] = inv[i - 1] * inv[i] % mod;
        }
    }

    static long mod_pow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = result * base % mod;
            base = base * base % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long k = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long mod = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());

        initialize((int)(n + 5), mod);

        if (n % 2 == 1) {
            System.out.println(mod_pow(k, n, mod));
        } else {
            List<Integer> megumi = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i += 2) {
                if ((i & n) == i) {
                    megumi.add(i);
                }
            }
            int limit = Math.min(17, (int)k);
            long[][] dp = new long[20][(int)n + 1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(dp[i], 0);
            }
            long answer = 0;
            dp[0][(int)n] = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= limit; i++) {
                long tmpans = 0;
                for (int val : megumi) {
                    if (dp[i - 1][val] == 0) continue;
                    int Megumi = val & (val - 1);
                    int step = Megumi ^ val;
                    for (int k_ = step; k_ <= Megumi; k_ += step) {
                        if ((k_ & Megumi) == k_) {
                            long val_dp = dp[i - 1][val] * p[val] % mod * inv[k_] % mod * inv[val - k_] % mod;
                            dp[i][k_] = (dp[i][k_] + val_dp) % mod;
                        }
                    }
                    tmpans = (tmpans + dp[i - 1][val]) % mod;
                }
                answer = (answer + tmpans * inv[k - i] % mod) % mod;
            }
            answer = answer * p[(int)k] % mod;
            long final_ans = (mod_pow(k, n, mod) - answer) % mod;
            if (final_ans < 0) final_ans += mod;
            System.out.println(final_ans);
        }
    }
}
